dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But you want to make it interesting, don't you?

dialogues.speaker: Ehrnrooth
dialogues.text: I should've slapped myself... No, a slap isn't nearly enough — I wish I'd stuffed my fist in my mouth to prevent me from saying a thing back then.

dialogues.speaker: Ehrnrooth
dialogues.text: That way, I wouldn't be stuck pulling my hair out, unable to write down a single word.
